# Loom Agent

> Loom Agent V0.4 is a TypeScript, CLI-first, local durable multi-agent runtime with persisted task graphs, parent-child delegation, task leases, an internal A2A bus, isolated context and memory, result handoff, approvals, verified execution, and SQLite recovery.
